slides.body: A dasha (planetary period) works like a season. Venus's season brings harmony, taste and connection into focus.
Venus (Shukra) rules relationships, beauty, comfort and negotiation. In its dasha, these areas tend to get more attention.
This is a partnerships quarter. Alliances, collaborations and design quality matter more than raw speed.
Trust built now compounds. Good partners, clear agreements and polished work become assets over the years.

points: Invest in two or three key partnerships

slides.body: Too much Venus can mean comfort-seeking and avoiding hard talks. Balance harmony with honesty.
